notes: Claims numbered by sentence in first-pass order (summary, keyPoints, body). Removed: leaflet minute/shared-objects claim (NI Direct says objects unlikely), friends/family claim, any-conditioner, comb times, pregnancy pack note, no treatment for lice-free family, Welsh school wording, treat without GP, other treatments, Welsh Common Ailments Scheme, NHS 111 line. Kept rash link since NHS inform lists rash on back of neck. nhs.uk page itself could not be fetched; blended summaries attributed it. Lead author removed the plant-oil list and the "permethrin not recommended" sentence: the checker could not pin them to a page and the permethrin statement looked wrong.
